items.text: \ In Loomii-Pon, haptic feedback for controllers has been added.
\ In Journey and Playlists, fixed a bug where the UI would not properly display after exiting.
If you run into problems running or playing the game, please check the Support page of the lumines.game website or file a support ticket on Zendesk.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646989/57ad7919b507344602bf88eacf6a3e487ec10094.jpg"]
\ Updated the default graphics settings for Steam Deck.
\ Added an extra trophy check to fix issues where certain trophies were not unlocking or displaying properly.
\ Added the ability to turn off whether Loomii will appear after a Burst. Go to Options>Accessibility>Post-Burst Loomii to configure.
\ In Burst Battle, fixed a bug where performing a Burst of 0 would use the previous Burst value.
\ In Journey mode, fixed a bug in phase three of Slice & Dice where fruits and vegetables would interfere with the playfield even when background effects were set to Very Subtle.
\ In local Burst Battle, fixed a bug where the second player’s controller wouldn’t vibrate.
\ In Options, fixed a bug where changing tabs quickly would not load the option text.
\ Fixed other minor UI and text issues.
If you run into problems running or playing the game, please check the Support page of the lumines.game website or file a support ticket on Zendesk.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646989/650766d4622db88556d2cf43a13e48c6e5f67c1c.jpg"]
\ In Customize, items unlocked and available will now sort to the top of each category.
\ Added a new graphic setting: Handheld Mode. This preset enables optimizations specifically for Steam Deck and other handheld devices. Let us know how it works on yours!
\ Across all modes, updated blocks for better visibility with Color Filter settings enabled. Let us know what you think!
\ In Burst Battle, added a Local Match button, making it easier to set up a couch match against a friend on a second controller or a Vs CPU game.
\ In Burst Battle, adjusted Ranked Match matching to more accurately pair similar-level players.
\ In Leaderboard League, added a High Score display to the UI to show your personal best while playing.
\ In Journey mode, added the ability to retain the block position during transitions. Go to Options>Game>Retain Block Positions to enable it.
\ In Journey mode, updated the readability of blocks on the Sphere stage during Burst.
\ In Leaderboard League, added an option to use the tutorial blocks for improved readability. Go to Options > Accessibility > Leaderboard League Blocks to adjust.
\ In Customize, added an option to randomize your preferred block set for Burst Battle.
\ Fixed a bug where the game would not close properly and remain as a task in the background. If you experienced this, please let us know if this fixes the issue.
\ Fixed a bug where the game would softlock if the player used Alt + Tab just before topping out.
\ In Journey mode, fixed a bug where the music could stop playing in the Duo Soul, Rain Steps, and Spider Webs stages.
\ In Options, updated the Color Filter options to better describe the setting (Protanopia, Deuteranopia, Tritanopia).
\ In Options > Controls, fixed a bug where buttons would not properly update.
\ Fixed other minor UI and text issues.
We continue to work on several major issues reported by users since launch and appreciate your patience!
Server connection issues - We know a lot of players are seeing frequent connection errors. We are looking into these and hope to have a fix soon.

Burst Battle softlock - We’ve had reports that when one opponent disconnects, they aren’t replaced by a CPU player, and the game essentially softlocks. We are looking into this and hope to have a fix soon.
Additional Quality of Life features - We are following all the feedback and comments from our community and are planning more quality of life fixes in an upcoming patch.
If you run into problems running or playing the game, please check the Support page of the lumines.game website or file a support ticket on Zendesk.
Some quick examples of the color filter improvements now available in Options>Accessibility. The Protanopia setting is shown in these screens.

Hey Lumines Arise players, It's been almost a month now since we launched on 11/11. A lot of you have already shared your thoughts on the game by leaving us a review on Steam (thank you!) or commenting via social media. We are very happy with the response to the game and hope you're enjoying all that Lumines Arise has to offer.

In fact, we whipped up this Accolades trailer just to go over some of the amazing critical responses to the game. [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KxLZT9ouu7s"]Heads up that we are releasing a patch today that includes quite a few excellent quality-of-life fixes and some changes to the colorblind filter presentation that we hope will make the game easier to parse for some players. In addition, there's now a "Handheld Mode" graphic option that you should use if you are playing on Steam Deck or other handheld PC.
Look out for that and check out the full patch notes for more on all the fixes.
-Enhance

Lumines Arise Patch 1.0.9 （11/26/25)
Bug Fixes and Improvements
\ In Journey, Playlist, and Challenges, fixed a bug that caused framerate drops during gameplay. This bug was introduced in the last patch—thank you to all who reported this!
We continue to work on several major issues reported by users since launch and appreciate your patience!
Server connection issues - We know a lot of players are seeing frequent connection errors. We are looking into these and hope to have a fix soon.

Readability and colorblindness - We are investigating ways to improve the playfield's overall readability for all players via in-game settings. Simultaneously, we are planning to make adjustments to the existing colorblind settings based on player feedback. Stay tuned!

Background task not ending - We have received reports from some users that the game stays in memory on Steam and cannot be closed even via the Task Manager. If you’re experiencing this issue, please file a support ticket on Zendesk and include as much information as you can about your setup, and attach a Dxdiag file if possible.
Additional Quality of Life features - We are following all the feedback and comments from our community and are planning more quality of life fixes in upcoming patches.
If you run into problems running or playing the game, please check the Support page of the lumines.game website or file a support ticket on Zendesk.

Lumines Arise Patch 1.0.8 （11/19/25)
Bug Fixes and Improvements
\ Fixed a bug where columns of blocks would sometimes disappear during Burst.
\ Adjusted the Customize screen so that customization items acquired from Weekend Loomii Live events are immediately reflected.
\ The rankings under Data will now display local scores even when the player is not ranked.
\ In Burst Battle, fixed a bug where music would loop continuously after starting a match while in the customization block selection screen.
\ In Burst Battle, fixed a bug where the VS screen animation and the Burst count would not be visible if a match was started while the player was in the Data or Customize screens.
\ Fixed various UI elements and localization text.
\ In the Options screen, fixed a bug where players could not navigate to other option tabs after entering the "Graphics" tab.
\ Fixed a bug where the game ignored your launch settings and launched in VR mode if a VR headset was connected.
\ In Journey's Survival mode, fixed a bug where some sounds would stop playing, and if play continued, the final stage could not be cleared.
\ Fixed a bug where the UI on the playfield could become invisible.
\ In Journey mode, fixed a bug where the cursor would behave incorrectly after opening and closing the Options menu when selecting difficulty.

We hope you've been enjoying the Lumines Arise Demo. Be sure to play before the demo period ends on September 3, 2025, at 11:59 pm local time. We have just released the first patch to the Demo, and here’s what it addresses:
Bug Fixes and Improvements
\ Fixed a bug that caused a connection error right before a Burst Battle match.
\ Fixed an issue where a login error could appear when starting up the game.
\ Text localization updates for Chinese. 修复部分中文本地化问题
If you run into problems running or playing the Demo, please check the Support page of the lumines.game website or file a support ticket on Zendesk.
